courses.title: Freelance Content Writing
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in freelance content writing for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on writing, translation and professional communication skills. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. Supports blog writing, product descriptions, translation work and clear business communication. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
courses.schedule: Four live classes per week. Exact class days and timings will be shared with registered participants.
learningOutcomes: Write clear product and service descriptions
Structure short articles and social captions
Edit for clarity and basic grammar
Adapt tone for different audiences
requirements: Smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection
Willingness to attend scheduled live Zoom sessions
Notebook or digital document for exercises and notes
Basic reading and writing ability in English and/or Urdu
